name: tetoncounty-us
description: A fast, source-linked field guide to Victor, Driggs, and Teton Valley.

scripts.check: node scripts/prepare.mjs && astro check && astro build && npm test && node scripts/check.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run check && node scripts/preflight.mjs && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run check:dev && node scripts/preflight.mjs --env dev && wrangler deploy --env dev
scripts.db:migrate:dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env dev --remote
